title: Frequency files: Peak ticket
summary: Count occurrences of each distinct reading, then produce those counts in increasing order of the associated numeric reading. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.
descriptionMd:
Identical inventory tags have been scattered among several loose folders. Pia is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

Count occurrences of each distinct reading, then produce those counts in increasing order of the associated numeric reading.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement frequencyFilesPeakTicket(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Frequency maps. Count occurrences of each distinct reading, then produce those counts in increasing order of the associated numeric reading. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n + d log d); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with frequency maps. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

Count occurrences of each distinct reading, then produce those counts in increasing order of the associated numeric reading. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [1,1,2,1]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 2.
The derived sequence is [1,3]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 3.
The derived sequence is []. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 0.
